## Highlights

- **Unified citation numbering** — one numbering registry per turn now covers the initial context blocks, search/grep hits, opened notes, and the source cards. The numbers used in the thinking trace, the answer body, and the rendered source cards are the same numbers, and they stay stable for the whole turn.
- Source cards render the true citation numbers (ascending, gaps allowed), and the numbers are persisted so re-opened conversations keep them.
- `grep_notes` and `get_active_note` results now carry citation numbers too; truncated tool results no longer drop their note paths.
- Prompt contract refreshed across all 11 UI languages: citation numbers are system-assigned per turn, and the source list is submitted only via the `sources` argument (never written into the answer body).

## Fixes

- Indexing no longer fails with "cannot commit - no transaction is active" when multiple notes are processed concurrently (per-note transaction serialization + rollback hardening).
- The conversation view now follows the bottom properly: sending a question pins the view to the new exchange, thinking steps scroll into view, and streaming no longer breaks follow after the thinking preview expands.
- The "New chat" button now follows UI language switching immediately.
- Dark-mode shimmer on the thinking status line renders as text again (gradient was painting as a solid block).

## UI

- Chat input minimum height reduced to 60px; the input wrapper no longer draws a border.
